name: verikit-local
description: Local-development marketplace for the VeriKit Claude Code plugin (HarmonyOS Kit selection). Add by absolute path, then /plugin install verikit@verikit-local. The committed runtime/ and skills/ work without a build; dist/ is only generated host packages.
